author: blu
body: The Camera effect is the right to look through the machine's camera. It is a bare marker here, the way Microphone is: capture and capture-raw are not declared in this chapter.

author: blu
body: They were, once, as effect operations with no handler, so a call died at emit with CDX2040. Unlike Location and Sensors, the hardware is real: codex-vm presents a UVC camera on root port 3 and delivers frames over isochronous transfers, and Works chapter GopUsbCam drives it. So capture is not a constant anywhere -- it is a frame off the wire.
